scope: Six complete published static coefficient and planar Holder deductions with exact application joins; actual scoped adoption requires root reading every check/finding/input limitation

reported_checks.claim: For static gamma_chi=c|x|^(-chi), d in {2,3}, 1<chi<2, full total-order coefficients B_k(t)=sum_{m=0}^{2k} E[U_m U_{2k-m}] obey B_0=1 and B_k(t)<=C_st^k t^((4-chi)k)/(k!)^(3-chi).
Isotropic Riesz interpolation in d=2,3 yields A_k(t)<=C^k t^((4-alpha-alpha0)k)/(k!)^(3-alpha) and E u^2<=exp(q C^{1/q} t^kappa) with C=C_low^theta C_st^(1-theta), C_low=2 Z_b0 pi V_1.
Planar Gamma of degree alpha admits finite angular mass S, weighted endpoints Gamma_low=|x|^{alpha-1}Gamma and Gamma_st=|x|^{alpha-chi}Gamma, closing bound S/4, and unnormalized Gaussian Holder.
Arbitrary nonnegative even PD tempered Radon Xi on R^2 with Xi(rA)=r^(2-chi)Xi(A), 1<chi<2, has C_st with B_k<=C_st^k t^((4-chi)k)/(k!)^(3-chi), B_0=1.
Planar homogeneous-covariance upper bound: A_k(t)<=C^k t^((4-alpha-alpha0)k)/(k!)^(3-alpha), E u^2<=exp(q C^{1/q} t^kappa), C=C_low^theta C_st^(1-theta), C_low=Z_b0 S.
In d=2 the upper bound E u^2<=exp(C_2 t^kappa) holds throughout 0<alpha<2-alpha0 with zero-covariance convention u=1, C_2=0.
Actual static class and p2 total-order coefficient with published 5.15 coefficient/log type.
Holder at common positive diagram measure with actual regularized Gaussian/Bochner limits and Green-before-noise order.
Planar endpoint constants and full strict parameter window.

Singular-line parameters, amplitudes 1 and 3, dilation/p2 multiplier, spectral closing and unnormalized Holder.

No tools, build, search, execution, delegation, or hidden-model fallback were used; all verification is by inspection of the supplied text and by hand reconstruction of the supplied arithmetic.
No source-image/render or whole-main manual re-derivation was performed; primary text verification used the provided text-only editions at the stated pinpoints.
The inherited published theorems are accepted as imported inputs per the stated scope; this review does not constitute an independent proof of Chen--Hu or Chen2023.
